bugs.title: Fixed missing Intel, MediaTek and NVIDIA drivers
bugs.description: Due to changes introduced with the last Debian repo sync, Intel, MediaTek and NVIDIA drivers were not being installed by default.

enhancements.title: Added libfuse2-compat compatibility library
enhancements.description: Replaced libfuse2t64 with libfuse2-compat compatibility library which translates the FUSE2 ABI into FUSE3 for legacy AppImages.
